### How this was built
- Cohort: the five projects named — Sei Network, Lido Finance, Cosmos Hub, Pendle and Jito — each queried by its canonical identity.
- Window: 2023-03-01 through 2023-05-31, one row per calendar day (92 days), no aggregation.
- Measure: circulating supply, a point-in-time token count, read as each day's value.
- A dash shows a day with no observed value: Sei Network and Jito returned no circulating-supply observations in this window.
- Cosmos Hub (292,586,163) and Pendle (96,950,723) each returned a single unchanged value on every day of the window.
